content: We need to return mapped_rxn associated with the template that, when applied to the molecule (provided as available input data), reproduces the reaction: electrophilic bromination of aromatic ring. The forward reaction is bromination of aromatic ring, forming C-Br and halide functional group. We need retrosynthetic step: given product (the molecule) we need to find template that when applied to product gives precursors (starting material before bromination). The available input data: from previous step make_8_lvl2-apply_template-3, question: "Can you return all possible precursors of applying the template as the result of the task make_8_lvl2-template_search-3 to the molecule below?" answer: "[['CC(C)(C)OC(=O)N1CCNCC1', 'O=[N+]([O-])c1cc(Br)c2c(c1)CCC1(CCC1)O2']]" So the precursors are a protecting group (tert-butyl carbamate? Actually CC(C)(C)OC(=O)N1CCNCC1 is a protected amine maybe) and a brominated aromatic heterocycle O=[N+]([O-])c1cc(Br)c2c(c1)CCC1(CCC1)O2. The product likely is the same but with bromine? Wait the product after bromination would have Br attached; the precursor before bromination would have H instead of Br. So the template applied to product gave these precursors. The template ID we need to retrieve. We need to find which template was used in make_8_lvl2-template_search-3. We don't have that directly. We can search template catalog by criteria: functional group formed is halide (C-Br) and broken is hydrogen? The forward reaction forms halide functional group. So functional_groups_formed: "halide". functional_groups_broken: maybe "hydrogen". Let's get list of functional groups.
